subject.title: [Bug]: Chrome MCP existing-session `profile=user` reports ready but all page tools time out on macOS

question: Should the shipped `pageReady` and tab-timeout fixes be treated as enough for this report, or should this issue stay open for live macOS Chrome page-tool timeout reproduction?
rationale: Current source and related PRs prove only partial fixes; deciding whether the remaining all-page-tool timeout is still a supported-core bug needs maintainer-grade live proof or an explicit support-boundary decision.

options.title: Keep for live repro
options.body: Keep this issue open and use it to capture macOS Chrome `profile=user` page-tool timeout proof, upstream Chrome MCP behavior, and the resulting repair or diagnostic boundary.

options.title: Close as status-only
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide that honest `pageReady: false` diagnostics are the accepted outcome and this Chrome mode is not expected to provide page-tool control.

options.title: Route to extension/plugin approach
options.body: If real signed-in Chrome control should be extension-owned, document the core limit and route the remaining capability through a browser plugin or ClawHub package.

recommendation.title: Keep for live repro
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and use it to capture macOS Chrome `profile=user` page-tool timeout proof, upstream Chrome MCP behavior, and the resulting repair or diagnostic boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is currently assigned to steipete, and the remaining question is a maintainer proof/support-boundary decision.
